english.title: Fraudulently ship / make waterborne dutiable / restricted goods of which an entry is required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were concerned with the

(A)_[shipping for exportation]_
(B)_[shipping as stores]_
(C)_[making waterborne for shipment for exportation]_
(D)_[making waterborne for shipment as stores]_

with fraudulent intent of

(E)_[dutiable]_
(F)_[restricted]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), of which entry was required under section 53 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, before such entry had been delivered and accepted, having had knowledge of the fraudulent intent
english.legislation: Contrary to section 53(8) and (9) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: The financial penalty on summary conviction is a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
